author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time I decide to build my own gaming console after the decisions some of the biggest companies have taken recently. The future is one where we lose a lot of our consumer rights and I've decided to take a computer and turn it into something as simple as any console you can buy with all the advantages going forward. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: Screw Playstation, I Made The MutaStation...

author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Google proceeding with their plans to lock down how you install applications onto your phone. Google has been forced to show third parties for once but this is a small victory as they're proceeding to roll out verification for anyone who wants to share an app. Why is this bad? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: Google Is Locking Down Your Android Phone...
